player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop of guessing the same word, "messy", despite the feedback indicating that it was not the correct word. What's worse, I didn't learn from the feedback and didn't try to find a new word that uses the correct letters "s" and "y" in different positions. Next time, I will try to find a new word that keeps the correct letters "s" and "y" in the same positions, but uses them in a different context, and I will also try to use the correct letters in different positions. I will also make sure to keep track of the correct letters and their positions, and use that information to inform my next guess. For example, I can try to find a word that has "s" in the correct position, but also has a different letter in the position where "m" was previously.
